text_block_list.text:
Today is finally the day of Grass Wonder's 
Debut race...!

As she slowly takes deep breaths, she 
seems completely normal, but—

Is her condition good? Is her mental state 
stable? Does her leg feel completely 
normal? Are her shoelaces tied 
properly...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer. You seem rather restless, 
is everything all right?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Trainer is being nervous in my 
place, so there's no problem at all~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush, just stay as you always are. 
'A journey of a thousand miles begins with 
a single step,' after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The debut race I've been waiting for... 
First, let me show you a race that'll blow 
all your nerves away♪
